_comment: Brownian Bridge latent diffusion (train_bbdm.py). Diffuses data-to-data rather than data-to-noise; see the module docstring.

data._root_comment: target_root holds MRA re-exported from the chosen VAEv4/v5 checkpoint by export_latents.py. conditioning_root holds T1/T2/PD from the multimodal VAEv2. They are separate because the MRA latents are re-exported whenever the VAE changes and the conditioning ones are not.
data._crop_comment: FULL volume, no crop. The previous run trained this way and vessels span the whole brain -- a crop severs them at the boundary, which works against a topology objective. Measured 5.85 GB peak at batch 1, 0.245 s/step.
data._frangi_comment: precomputed Frangi vesselness, already stored at latent resolution (1,128,144,24) and cropped with the latents. Weights the x0-space losses toward vessels without decoding anything. train+val only; missing maps become zeros.
data._preload_comment: mmap instead of a 16.5 GB preload. On a 31.8 GB machine with the user apps running, the preload gets paged out: the process RSS fell 12.9 -> 6.1 GB and the GPU sat at 80 W of 360 W with 100 % reported utilisation -- waiting on page faults, not computing. Epochs went 325 s -> 2393 s. Per step this reads ~35 MB of latents, which the OS page cache serves fine.

vae._comment: used only at validation, to decode sampled latents into image space. MUST be the same checkpoint target_root was exported from.

model._comment: conditioning is NOT concatenated at the input. CondEncoder3D produces one feature map per level and AdaGNResBlock3D injects it as post-norm scale/shift, zero-initialised. v1 concatenated frozen VAE latents once at the input, which gave the network no way to adapt features trained to reconstruct T1/T2/PD rather than predict MRA.
model._sizing_comment: cond_base 48 gives a 5.32 M-parameter conditioning encoder, matching the 6.2 M one the previous working model used. Measured on an idle GPU: 46.3 M total, 8.43 GB peak at batch 1 on full 128x144x24 volumes, 0.240 s/step -> 15.1 h for 500 x 455. cond_base 24 was 1.34 M and only 0.4 h faster, so the larger encoder is nearly free.
model._projector_comment: BridgeProjector maps the 24 source channels to the 16-channel target space, giving the bridge its endpoint. It is a latent-space regressor and is trained both through the bridge and by an explicit L1 against x0.

diffusion._sampling_comment: REVIEW_2026-09-02 P1: the previous run drew 60 % of timesteps at t>=700 and applied x0-space losses at every timestep, which made it behave as a conditional-mean regressor. logit_normal concentrates on the mid-noise band that actually carries signal; 'uniform' is the fallback.
diffusion._min_snr_comment: Hang et al. 2023. For v-prediction the weight is min(SNR, gamma)/(SNR+1). Set gamma to 0 to disable.
diffusion._cfg_comment: No classifier-free guidance: the condition also defines the bridge endpoint, so dropping it removes the process rather than leaving an unconditional model.

losses._gate_comment: auxiliaries fire while m_t <= 0.8. Near m_t=1 the state IS the endpoint and x0 is only knowable through conditioning -- the regression regime, and the bridge analogue of v2's SNR gate.
losses._weight_comment: weights carried over from v2 and NOT yet calibrated against the bridge's own loss scale. Check the per-term shares in training.jsonl on the first epochs; every previous miscalibration in this project came from reusing a weight across a changed objective.

training._budget_comment: 15 h cap so the chain cannot overrun the unattended window. The run is resumable from latest.pt, so hitting the cap costs nothing but a restart.
training._amp_comment: bfloat16, NOT float16. There is no GradScaler in the loop, and sqrt(alpha_bar) reaches 1.0e-4 at t=999 against fp16's 6.1e-5 smallest normal -- fp16 would underflow silently. Same choice as the previous run. fp16 is used for VAE inference only, where there are no gradients.
training._workers_comment: Safe now. Windows spawns workers, which pickles the dataset; with the RAM cache included that was ~16.5 GB per worker and is why the previous LDM ran with VPRED_NUM_WORKERS=0. PairedLatentDataset.__getstate__ drops the cache, so a worker now receives 0.004 MB and reads via mmap. Measured 119 ms/batch at 0 workers (serial, ~23 h total) against 47.6 ms at 3 (overlapped, ~15.5 h). If workers still fail to start the loop prints a warning and falls back to 0 rather than dying.

validation._comment: the endpoint alone is scored every cycle, so 'the reverse process improves on its endpoint' stays measured rather than assumed.

output._rebuild_comment: the thesis run is checkpoints/ldm_bbdm (protected); new runs go to checkpoints/rebuild. data.conditioning_root 'latents' is the FIXED T1/T2/PD latent set; use latents_multimodal for a from-scratch rebuild.

bridge._comment: delta_t = 2*s*(m_t - m_t^2), zero at both endpoints, peak 0.5*s at m=1/2. Li et al. 2023 use s=1.
